description: Create a Template - Create a new email template. Attachments are not supported on this connector — to send files, attach them via the SalesBlink web app.

attachments.description: NOT supported on this connector — providing file paths returns an error. Attach files via the SalesBlink web app instead.

content.description: HTML content of the email template

folder.description: Optional general folder ID to organize the template. Must be a folder created without a type (i.e., not an email-sender folder). An empty string removes the template from its folder.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.

name: create_template

result.description: The raw result returned by the SalesBlink tool.

title: Create Template
